Strike · Bulgaria

Bulgaria reports unidentified ship sunk in drone attack off Krapets

13 October 2026 · Off Krapets · Drone strike and ship sinking

Officially reported drone attack and sinking; vessel identity and operator unresolved

On the morning of 13 October 2026, during an emergency Security Council meeting, Radev announced that a second vessel had been hit in a drone attack and had sunk in the Black Sea, reportedly 17 nautical miles east of Krapets in Dobrich Province. The location was in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone, outside its territorial waters. The exact times of the strike and the sinking were not disclosed.

The ship has not been identified, and the number, model and type of drones, aerial or maritime, are unconfirmed. Drone causation and other operational details remain preliminary. The operator and nationality are unresolved: Radev said the evidence was insufficient to accuse either belligerent, and his argument that the attacks benefit Russia does not establish Russian responsibility.

One crew member was reported rescued. The total crew, injuries and fate of the others were not disclosed, so no death or missing toll can be given. No drone wreckage recovery was reported. The sinking is separate from the drone strike on CHELSEA 3 the same day, which happened at another location.
